name: wellnessblock-ai
description: WellnessBlock AI - Block-based wellness tracker with local and AWS production runtimes

scripts.deploy:infra: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file infra/cloudformation.yaml --stack-name WellnessBlockAI --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM --parameter-overrides Environment=production
scripts.deploy:code: tsx src/scripts/build-lambda.ts && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name WellnessBlock-Handler-production --zip-file fileb://dist/lambda.zip
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:infra && npm run deploy:code
